base_without_esme.note: the same scenes with Esme and Mr Cat left out, for when the game draws her itself

looks: Pick the base by state and look. Look follows Rio's weather and clock: night after dark (rain at night shows the night base), rain when it is raining in the day, day otherwise.

rain.note: transparent 384x240 frames; loop them over the rain base. They leave the dry band under the awning clear.

tv.note: the bar TV always shows a Brighton and Hove Albion game (blue-and-white stripes, white shorts) against a red side. Loop the frames in order (0, 1, 2) over the full base at 'at', about 220 ms a frame. Each frame is the screen's size and transparent where someone stands in front of it. With reduced motion, show nothing: the base already shows frame 0.

foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the sticker frame; draw at left = x - w//2, top = y - h + 1
draw_order: sort every sticker by foot y (then x), back to front; draw stickers after the base

start.note: the boteco has just opened (day 45, or held by a stuck task): shutters half up, one table, the owner sweeping, pigeons

full.note: the boteco in full swing: every table out, the roda de samba, the waiter, Esme and Mr Cat. Suggestion: switch when half the boteco stickers are earned (Core to decide)

door.note: the corner door (and the three open bays): walking in goes to inside/inside-slots.json

esme_spot.note: feet of Esme and Mr Cat as drawn in the full scenes

dry_band.note: under the awning: stays dry in the rain look

baked: building, neighbour's house, pavement, kerb, road, almond tree and ring bench, lamp, orelhao, palm, taxi, crates, chalkboard, tables and stools, people (per state and look)

slots.note: on the balcony slab, a pot or a birdcage (up to 16x16)
hung on a pillar above the tiles (up to 10x12)
on the first yellow table (the one there from day one), up to 12x12
under the almond tree's crown, up to 16x16
on the side pavement, up to 24x32
parked at the kerb: a cart, a scooter, a bike (up to 48x28)
